notes.text: Status renders the round-done item as '$done: gh-12: triage round done, no PR' — step prefix and a repeated story key; cosmetic, worth a look.

Downgrade hazard (outside this slice's criteria): if released 0.15.0 ticks a checkout holding a story already in round folders, it reads the story as not started and runs story.start again, writing a fresh flat state.json next to rounds/. The dev build then sees both (the resolver prefers flat while state.json exists) and its migrate would collide. AGENTS.md's recovery for a broken release is to reinstall the previous binary, so it may be worth a follow-up issue.
Plan prefactor 2 lists mailbox refs among close's effects, but story close never deleted them; kept unchanged here. Should GR6b/close delete refs/norn/mailbox/<story>/*?

Integration flake: packages/cli/test/integration/check-run.test.ts:146 (two long checks, K1/K3) got an extra run_check under 12x parallel load; unchanged by this slice, green 3/3 alone. Worth a friction issue if it recurs.
